description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of git-apply with regard to path escaping and safety features. It defines test cases to verify that paths containing '..' and symlinks do not escape the working directory when applying patches.

methods.name: mkpatch_add
methods.description: Creates a patch for adding a new file with specified content.

methods.name: mkpatch_del
methods.description: Creates a patch for deleting a specified file.

methods.name: mkpatch_symlink
methods.description: Creates a patch for adding a symlink with specified target.
